GAP_AMENDMENT: Test must patch _classify_tier_via_bash helper (not subprocess.run directly) to avoid breaking unrelated subprocess calls.

Updated test approach:
- Patch 'dso_ci_review.runner._classify_tier_via_bash' returning {'selected_tier': 'standard', ...} mock dict
- Assert _classify_tier_via_bash was called once with the diff_text argument
- Also add a second test: test_runner_bash_classifier_timeout_falls_back — patches _classify_tier_via_bash to raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired, asserts runner falls back to standard tier and completes (does not raise)

This replaces the original 'patch subprocess.run' approach in the task description.
